image_description: A large, elongated soap bubble floats in the foreground of a black-and-white urban street scene. The bubble is the only colored element, displaying vibrant iridescent rainbow patterns (greens, pinks, blues, golds) against a monochrome background featuring a graffiti-covered utility pole, pedestrians, and buildings. The bubble's surface reflects and distorts the background environment.
